# core-cenf-ts

> TypeScript port of core-cenf-py. 19 infrastructure managers. Clean Architecture (Ports & Adapters). 708 tests.

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CENFARG/core-cenf-ts.git
cd core-cenf-ts
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test           # 708 tests
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
```

## Architecture Principle

> Depend on Protocols, inject Adapters. Never import adapters in business logic.

```typescript
// CORRECT — depend on port (interface)
import type { CacheManager } from './ports/cache-manager.port.js';

// WRONG — avoid direct adapter imports
import { RedisCacheAdapter } from '../infrastructure/cache/redis-cache.adapter.js';
```

## 19 Managers

| # | Manager | Port | Adapter | Python Sibling |
|---|---------|------|---------|---------------|
| 1 | Config | `ConfigManager` | Zod schema / typed env | M01 ConfigManager |
| 2 | Logging | `LogManager` | pino | M02 LoggerManager |
| 3 | Secret | `SecretManager` | env / vault / memory | M03 SecretManager |
| 4 | ErrorHandling | `ErrorHandlingManager` | @handle_errors decorator | M04 ErrorHandlingManager |
| 5 | Validation | `ValidationManager` | Zod | M12 FeatureFlagManager |
| 6 | Observability | `ObservabilityManager` | @opentelemetry/api | M05 ObservabilityManager |
| 7 | Auth | `AuthManager` | jose (JWT) | M06 AuthManager |
| 8 | Cache | `CacheManager` | ioredis (Redis) | M07 CacheManager |
| 9 | FeatureFlag | `FeatureFlagManager` | YAML / memory | M12 |
| 10 | RateLimiter | `RateLimiterManager` | Token bucket (zero deps) | M16 RateLimiterManager |
| 11 | Database | `DatabaseManager` | Drizzle / Prisma | M08 DatabaseManager |
| 12 | Storage | `StorageManager` | @aws-sdk/client-s3 | M09 FileStorageManager |
| 13 | HttpClient | `HttpClientManager` | undici + retry | M11 ExternalAPIManager |
| 14 | CircuitBreaker | `CircuitBreakerManager` | opossum | — |
| 15 | EventBus | `EventBusManager` | @nats-io/nats-core v3 | M21 BusEventManager |
| 16 | I18n | `I18nManager` | i18next | M17 I18nManager |
| 17 | JsonSerializer | `JsonSerializer` | Native BigInt-safe JSON | — |
| 18 | Health | `HealthManager` | Aggregated health checks | — |
| 19 | Bootstrap | `BootstrapOrchestrator` | Lifecycle wiring | BootstrapOrchestrator |

## File Structure

```
src/
├── index.ts                     Public API exports
├── managers/
│   ├── config/                  M01 — Zod-typed config
│   ├── logging/                 M02 — pino logger
│   ├── secret/                  M03 — Encrypted secrets
│   ├── error-handling/          M04 — Error classification
│   ├── validation/              M05 — Zod validation
│   ├── observability/           M06 — OpenTelemetry
│   ├── auth/                    M07 — JWT auth (jose)
│   ├── cache/                   M08 — Redis cache (ioredis)
│   ├── feature-flag/            M09 — Runtime toggles
│   ├── rate-limiter/            M10 — Token bucket
│   ├── database/                M11 — Drizzle/Prisma
│   ├── storage/                 M12 — S3 storage
│   ├── http-client/             M13 — undici+retry
│   ├── circuit-breaker/         M14 — opossum
│   ├── event-bus/               M15 — NATS JetStream
│   ├── i18n/                    M16 — i18next
│   ├── json-serializer/         M17 — BigInt-safe JSON
│   ├── health/                  M18 — Health checks
│   └── bootstrap/               M19 — Lifecycle orchestration
└── shared/
    ├── errors.ts                CenfError hierarchy
    ├── types.ts                 Shared types
    ├── context.ts               AsyncLocalStorage wrapper
    └── lifecycle.ts             AsyncLifecycle interface
```

## @ai-directive (Agent Instructions)

- **TDD strict**: Write test first. Always.
- **Port/Adapter**: Every manager starts with a port interface.
- **Clean Architecture**: Domain logic never depends on infrastructure.
- **Testing**: vitest (unit + integration + e2e)
- **Commits**: Work-unit commits. Chained PRs for >400 lines.
- **Python sibling**: Use core-cenf-py as pattern reference. Adapt, don't copy.

## Error Taxonomy

```typescript
import { TransientError, PermanentError, ValidationError, AuthError, RateLimitError } from './shared/errors.js';
```

## Context Propagation

```typescript
import { context } from './shared/context.js';
context.run({ correlationId: 'req-123', tenantId: 'cntrs' }, async () => {
  // All downstream calls inherit context via AsyncLocalStorage
});
```

## Testing

```bash
pnpm test                    # 708 tests
pnpm test -- --coverage     # With coverage
```

## Key Files

- `AGENTS.md` — Full agent instructions (105 lines)
- `AGENTS_API.md` — Structured catalog of all 19 managers
- `api-catalog.json` — Machine-parseable API reference
- `package.json` — Workspace config, scripts
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — Monorepo workspace
- `tsconfig.base.json` — Shared TypeScript config
- `turbo.json` — Turborepo pipeline
- `vitest.config.ts` — Test configuration
- `.codegraph/` — Pre-indexed knowledge graph
- `.chats/decisions.yaml` — Strategic architecture decisions
